content: Shijiazhuang Henryte Chemicals Co., Ltd. is a professional, ISO-certified chemical enterprise headquartered at No. 166 Yuhua Road (West), Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province—China’s pivotal chemical industry hub and provincial capital. Established with a commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainability, Henryte specializes in the research, development, production, and global distribution of high-purity organic and inorganic chemical intermediates, specialty catalysts, fine chemicals, and custom-synthesized compounds for pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, dyes, coatings, and advanced materials industries. Equipped with modern GMP-compliant manufacturing facilities, advanced analytical laboratories (including HPLC, GC-MS, ICP-MS, and NMR capabilities), and a rigorous quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 standards, the company maintains strict compliance with international regulatory requirements—including REACH, FDA guidelines, and ICH standards. Henryte’s dedicated R&D team—comprising experienced chemists and process engineers—collaborates closely with universities and research institutes to accelerate product innovation and green process optimization. Serving clients across more than 40 countries in Asia, Europe, North America, and Latin America, the company emphasizes reliable supply chain management, responsive technical support, and responsible stewardship of environmental and occupational health and safety. With a vision to become a globally trusted partner in high-value chemical solutions, Shijiazhuang Henryte Chemicals Co., Ltd. continues to invest in sustainable technologies, digital manufacturing, and talent development—solidifying its reputation as a dynamic, ethical, and technically proficient contributor to China’s advanced chemical sector and the global life sciences supply chain.
